about: Golden prompts — each is a request someone might give Lovable, Cursor or Claude with FPDS installed. `expect` is what the build protocol must answer. Checked by `npm run eval` (fpds-gaps, through scripts/fpds/resolve.mjs) and used by hand in each tool (rubric in evals/README.md).

prompts.prompt: A vendors list for 3PL with filters, saved views and export
Delivery orders as a kanban board with lanes by status
Show service technicians on a map with their trucks
Create a new fuel order form with products, quantity and top off
Edit a quote with documents and attachments
Create a recurring delivery with a frequency and a delivery window
A dashboard for Sales with KPI tiles for today
Settings page to configure SLA hours for the Service module
Customer portal page listing my invoices with a date range
Bulk select orders and change the planned date
Customer record profile page with ship-tos and history
Show an alert banner when tanks are nearly empty
Orders list where each order shows a status pill and awaiting confirmation
An onboarding welcome tour for new customers with an illustration
A week calendar view of technician jobs
A chat between the dispatcher and the driver on an order
Sales dashboard with a funnel chart of quotes
Capture the customer's signature on delivery
A drag and drop workflow builder for approvals
